name: What is involved in converting a garage into living space?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in converting a garage into living space?

acceptedAnswer.text: A garage conversion converts an unconditioned vehicle bay into finished, climate-controlled living space such as a family room, home office, guest suite, or gym. The process involves framing over or replacing the overhead garage door with an exterior wall, insulating the ceiling and perimeter walls, framing interior partitions, leveling the concrete slab, and hanging drywall. Mechanical trades handle dedicated electrical wiring, lighting, and heating or cooling extensions. HH Remodeling LLC handles the custom framing, drywall, interior trim, paint, and flooring directly, while coordinating licensed trade partners to run necessary electrical circuits or plumbing lines.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage conversion encloses the door, insulates, levels floors, installs drywall, and adds heating, cooling, and electrical to turn parking space into a functional room.
